meta.title: Jev Chat Moderator · playground
meta.description: Jev, TypeSafe AI's System One model, moderating a live-stream chat in real time.
intro.text: jev-chat-moderator reads every message in a chat and says how likely it is to be offensive, and what kind. The decision to delete is made by code, using the thresholds you set.

policy.title: Policy
policy.hint: Move the thresholds: messages are re-evaluated instantly, without calling Jev again.
policy.legend: Offensive probability ≥ remove → deleted. Between review and remove → a human takes a look. High-probability spam is deleted too.

about.title: What is Jev?
about.p1: Jev is a “System One” model by TypeSafe AI. Instead of generating text, it takes a state plus typed questions and returns typed answers with probabilities, very fast and very cheap.
about.p2: For each message we ask it two questions in a single call: is it offensive? (yes/no with a probability) and what kind is it? (normal, insult, hate, spam or threat).
about.p3: Jev works best in English; in Spanish it does well, but with less confidence. Keep an eye on the review zone.
detail.title: What Jev answered
live.typesafeLocalOnly: TypeSafe keys only work with the playground running on your machine, because their API doesn't accept calls from other websites. Clone the repo and run: docker compose up --build (then open http://localhost:8080). Here you can use a Vercel AI Gateway key.
